confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use recent Reykjavík price aggregates and local price data. Accommodation is modeled for July high season and is less certain; wine is estimated at roughly 1.15 times the draft beer price because glass-price data was limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy used; food and drink estimates are Reykjavík-specific, and accommodation is modeled for Reykjavík in July.
